concept: A protective moon-tide haven with soft shell architecture and calm pearl light.
floor: One continuous smooth moon-blue sea-glass stone floor across the full top face, with broad pearly shading and no water, grass, tiles, symbols, rings, or repeated pattern.
main_structure: One large open shell-inspired alcove at the rear made from three broad rounded pearl slabs around a luminous moon-blue interior, abstract rather than animal-like.
side_props: three large rounded lavender shell-stone forms on the upper-left edge
two broad moon-blue crystal forms on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous rounded pearl-stone wall with broad moon-blue cap blocks

lighting: soft moonlit ambient light with broad pearl lantern glow
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open sea-glass stone floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature, crab, animal, egg, or familiar baked into the bitmap
pool, open water, zodiac glyph, constellation, text, center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, watermark, external shadow, bubbles, tiny shells, pebbles, cracks, specks, or dense clutter
